text: とくべつに　ヒントを　おしえよう！

structure.jp: ヒントを　おしえよう！

patterns.name: 〜よう
patterns.explanation: よう on the end of a verb says the speaker has decided to do it: 'I'll do it' or 'let's do it'. おしえよう = 'I'll tell you'.

patterns.name: 〜に (adverb)
patterns.explanation: に after a word like 'special' turns it into a word that says how something is done. とくべつに = 'specially, as a special favor'.
